mapper.select: select plan_id, plan_name, cron_expression, job_id, report_style, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from sup_tim_inspection_plan where plan_id = #{planId}

select plan_item_id, plan_id, item_code, item_name, item_type, enabled_flag, sort_order, threshold_value, threshold_unit, compare_rule, time_window_minutes, timeout_seconds, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from sup_tim_inspection_plan_item where plan_id = #{planId} order by sort_order asc, plan_item_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into sup_tim_inspection_plan_target(plan_id, item_code, target_id, create_by, create_time) values (#{planId}, #{itemCode}, #{targetId}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select t.target_id, t.item_code, t.target_name, t.target_type, t.server_id, s.server_name, s.server_address, t.host, t.port, t.path, t.url, t.http_method, t.topic, t.consumer_group, t.username, t.password_cipher, t.app_key, t.secret_cipher, t.result_path, t.extra_params, t.status, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark from sup_tim_inspection_plan_target pt inner join sup_tim_inspection_target t on t.target_id = pt.target_id and t.status = '0' left join sup_server s on s.server_id = t.server_id where pt.plan_id = #{planId} and pt.item_code = #{itemCode} order by pt.plan_target_id asc
